He played college basketball for the [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville Cardinals]]. ==Early life== Adel was born in [[Juba]] under what is now [[South Sudan]]. As a youth, he, his mother and five siblings fled war-torn Sudan and moved to [[Uganda]] to set up a move to [[Australia]] when Deng was 8 years of age. He settled in [[Melbourne]] in 2004 and lived in the suburbs of [[Fitzroy, Victoria|Fitzroy]] and [[Sunshine, Victoria|Sunshine]]. Basketball only came into Adel's life when his friends introduced him to it as a 14-year-old. From there, he began playing locally for the Sunshine Longhorns, and in 2012, he played for the [[Waverley Falcons]] in the [[Big V]].{{Cite web |url=http://www.smh.com.au/sport/basketball/rising-star-deng-adel-chases-nba-dream-with-louisville-cardinals-college-team-20150304-13uxm9.html |title=Rising star Deng Adel chases NBA dream with Louisville Cardinals college team |last=Ward |first=Roy |date=4 March 2015 |website=The Sydney Morning Herald |access-date=28 August 2015}}{{cite web | title = Player statistics for Deng Adel | url = http://www.foxsportspulse.com/team_info.cgi?action=PSTATS&pID=195990189&client=1-7930-99144-209843-16875477 | work = FoxSportsPulse.com | accessdate = 6 February 2016}} Growing up, Adel also played soccer and ran track.{{cite web | title = Deng Adel - 2015-16 Men's Basketball | url = http://www.gocards.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=5062 | work = GoCards.com | accessdate = 6 February 2016}} Adel attended high school at both [[Keilor Downs College]]{{cite web | title = Keilor Downs College Ex-Student, Reaching The Heights | url = http://www.kdc.vic.edu.au/keilor-downs-college-student-top-scorer-in-big-science-contest/ | work = kdc.vic.edu.au | date = 5 May 2015 | accessdate = 6 February 2016 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20160207012453/http://www.kdc.vic.edu.au/keilor-downs-college-student-top-scorer-in-big-science-contest/ | archive-date = 7 February 2016 | url-status = dead }} and [[Xavier College]]. In August 2013, he moved to the United States after landing a rare $20,000 basketball scholarship to Victory Rock Prep in [[Bradenton, Florida]].{{cite web | last = Lucas | first = Brendan | title = Melbourne teenager Deng Adel lands US basketball scholarship | url = http://www.heraldsun.com.au/news/victoria/melbourne-teenager-deng-adel-lands-us-basketball-scholarship/story-fni0fit3-1226703071382 | work = Herald Sun | date = 23 August 2013 | accessdate = 28 August 2015}} ==High school career== As a junior at Victory Rock Prep in 2013–14, Adel averaged 22 points and eight rebounds per game in helping the Blue Devils to a 24–8 record.{{cite web | title = Cards' Basketball Signing Class Among Nation's Best | url = http://www.gocards.com/news/2014/11/17/Cards_Basketball_Signing_Class_Among_Nation_s_Best.aspx | work = GoCards.com | date = 17 November 2014 | accessdate = 6 February 2016}} In November 2014, Adel signed a [[National Letter of Intent]] to play [[college basketball]] for the [[University of Louisville]]. Adel considered offers from [[Connecticut Huskies men's basketball|Connecticut]], [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida]], [[Ole Miss Rebels men's basketball|Mississippi]] and [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech]] before choosing to sign with the Cardinals. As a senior at Victory Rock Prep in 2014–15, Adel averaged 19.1 points, 8.2 rebounds and 4.0 assists per game in helping the Blue Devils to a 27–9 record. He subsequently earned all-state selection by the Florida Association of Basketball Coaches (FABC). ==College career== [[File:Deng Adel.jpg|thumb|right|Adel with the [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville Cardinals]] in 2018]] In May 2015, Adel enrolled in classes and moved to the University of Louisville for the first session of summer school.{{cite web | last = Greer | first = Jeff | title = Deng Adel enrolls at U of L, starts workouts | url = http://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/louisville/2015/05/11/deng-adel-enrolls-at-louisville-starts-workouts/27142863/ | work = Courier-Journal.com | date = 11 May 2015 | accessdate = 6 February 2016}} He later joined the [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville Cardinals]] for the 2015–16 season, and was made a starter for the team to begin his freshman campaign. He started for the Cardinals in the first two games of the season, averaging 4.5 points in 17 minutes while helping the team win both games. However, on 20 November, the day before the team's third game, Adel landed awkwardly in practice and was subsequently ruled out for three to six weeks with an [[Medial collateral ligament|MCL]] sprain in his left knee.{{cite web | last = Greer | first = Jeff | title = Louisville's Deng Adel has sprained MCL | url = http://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/louisville/2015/11/21/louisville-basketball-deng-adel-sprained-mcl-out-3-6-weeks/76188656/ | work = Courier-Journal.com | date = 21 November 2015 | accessdate = 6 February 2016}} He returned to full practice on 21 December,{{cite web | last = Greer | first = Jeff | title = Deng Adel nears return from knee injury | url = http://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/louisville/2015/12/19/louisville-basketball-deng-adel-nears-return-knee-injury/77640528/ | work = Courier-Journal.com | date = 19 December 2015 | accessdate = 6 February 2016}}{{cite web | last = Greer | first = Jeff | title = Louisville's Deng Adel returns to practice | url = = 6 February 2016}} and made his return to the court the following night against [[UMKC Kangaroos men's basketball|UMKC]].{{cite web | title = No. 16 Louisville pulls away from Missouri-Kansas City 75-47 | url = https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400839801 | work = ESPN.com | date = 22 December 2015 | access-date = 6 February 2016}} On 30 January 2016, he recorded season in U of L's loss | url = http://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/louisville/2016/01/30/louisville-virginia-deng-adel-plays-well/79568344/ | work = Courier-Journal.com | date = 30 January 2016 | accessdate = 6 February 2016}} On 6 February, he had a season-best game with 13 points, 7 rebounds, 4 assists and 2 steals in 34 minutes as a starter in a 79–47 win over [[Boston College Eagles men's basketball|Boston College]].{{cite web | title = No. 19 Louisville rolls past Boston College 79-47 | url = https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400839750 | work = ESPN.com | date = 6 February 2016 | access-date = 13 March 2016}} As a junior, Adel led Louisville in scoring with 15.0 points per game and also pulled down 5.2 rebounds per game. After completing his junior year at Louisville, Adel announced his intentions on enter the [[2018 NBA draft]]. Originally, he entered the draft without hiring an agent, but after a few weeks, he hired an agent of his own accord, thus removing any chance of him returning to Louisville for his senior year at the university.{{cite news |last1=Moore |first1=Annie |title=Deng Adel to hire agent, stay in NBA Draft |url=http://www.nbc12.com/story/37912512/deng-adel-to-hire-agent-stay-in-nba-draft |accessdate=24 June 2018 |work=NBC12 |date=9 April 2018 |archive-date=24 June 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180624150520/http://www.nbc12.com/story/37912512/deng-adel-to-hire-agent-stay-in-nba-draft |url-status=dead }} ==Professional career== ===Raptors 905 (2018–2019)=== After going undrafted in the [[2018 NBA draft]], Adel signed with the [[Houston Rockets]] for the NBA Summer League.{{cite news |last1=Sayers |first1=Justin |title=Louisville's Deng Adel joins Houston Rockets for NBA Summer League |url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/college/louisville/2018/06/23/deng-adel-houston-rockets-nba-summer-league-louisville-basketball/728493002/ |accessdate=24 June 2018 |work=[[Louisville Courier Journal]] |date=23 June 2018}} On 14 September 2018, Adel signed with the [[Toronto Raptors]] on a training camp contract.{{cite web|title=Raptors Sign Adel and Collinsworth|url=https://www.nba.com/raptors/press-release/raptors-sign-adel-and-collinsworth|website=NBA.com|accessdate=14 September 2018|date=14 September 2018}} After appearing in two preseason games, Adel was waived on 12 October.{{cite web|title=Raptors Waive Four|url=https://www.nba.com/raptors/press-release/raptors-waive-four|website=NBA.com|accessdate=12 October 2018|date=12 October 2018}} After being waived by Toronto, Adel spent the 2018–19 season playing for Toronto's G-League affiliate, Raptors 905. Through mid-December, he averaged 12.0 points and 5.4 rebounds in 31.3 minutes per game.{{Cite web|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Deng-Adel/Summary/73139|title=Deng Adel Player Profile, Brooklyn Nets, News, Rumors, NBA Stats, NCAA Stats, G League Stats, International Stats, Events Stats, Game Logs, Bests, Awards - RealGM}} ===Cleveland Cavaliers (2019)=== On 15 January 2019, Adel web|url=https://www.cleveland.com/cavs/2019/01/cleveland_cavaliers_denver_nug_5.html|title=Cleveland Cavaliers cap brutal road trip with 124-102 loss against Denver Nuggets: Chris Fedor's instant
